title: UAAP: UST women roll to second straight win, crush Adamson
summary: University of Santo Tomas cruised to a second straight win in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Saturday, roaring past Adamson University 83-65 at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
